items.summary: Recommendation: authorize only existing bounded workstreams this cycle: measure deployed work, repair or close failed requests, maintain SearchWoot’s private gate, and continue read-only revalidation. Evidence: 0 proven improvements, 24 awaiting measurement, 8 failed requests, 19 repair items, and 127 approved proposals without execution. Revenue evidence for 2026-09-21 shows $4.92 aggregate commission that cannot be attributed to a site; site-attributed income is $0. AI usage cost was $887.67 for 2026-09-01–2026-09-24. Causality, ROI, and per-site allocation remain unknown. Smallest next step: CTO inspects existing failure artifacts and drains only repair-ready approved work. Will the owner authorize this disposition for the cycle?

Handoff: prioritize existing repair and measurement backlog before new ideas. Inspect failed implementation artifacts, document root cause, validation, and rollback, then requeue only repair-ready approved work; do not create duplicate proposals or production changes.

Update: keep SearchWoot private. Woot’s public terms do not establish rights for public commercial display, derivatives, caching, or alerts; legal, security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Continue only bounded read-only evidence work and draft preparation.

Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for continued private-preview evidence work. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access but not redistribution rights, while current public terms restrict commercial/public collection, derivatives, display, caching, and alerts. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, privacy, and owner gates remain incomplete. Recommendation: keep private and authorize only bounded read-only evidence work, failed-request repair or closure, and existing measurement gates.
